base_prompt:
A high-end stylised 3D animated feature film, cinematic and colourful, family comedy-adventure tone, expressive cartoon character animation with squash-and-stretch, detailed fur and fabric, soft global illumination, rich saturated colour, shallow depth of field, anamorphic widescreen framing, smooth professional camera work.
Setting: a gleaming high-tech garage bay at the base of the lighthouse, tool walls, hoses, polishing cloths, a circular launch hatch in the floor. Lighting: cool workshop spotlights with copper reflections.
In the shot: Princess Holly, a tiny fairy princess about the height of a teacup, with a shimmering fairy-pink dress, iridescent wings like soap bubbles that catch the light, a little silver tiara, rosy cheeks, and a slender wand that fizzes with small irregular pink sparks; Tomkin, an anthropomorphic tabby cat who walks upright, slim and wiry, with burnt-orange "artisanal copper" fur and darker copper tiger stripes, bright emerald-green eyes, long expressive whiskers, a smug confident half-smile, brass welding goggles pushed up on his forehead, and a leather tool belt full of tiny gadgets; the Sardine-Scanner, an elaborate brass-and-glass tracking instrument with spinning dials, a radar dish and small glowing screens showing swimming fish silhouettes.
Camera: Medium shot, Holly flying in toward the console.
Action: Holly flutters into the garage toward Tomkin, who stands protectively by his gleaming Sardine-Scanner. Her wand fizzes more and more as she talks.
Dialogue: Princess Holly (soft, sweet, gentle young female voice, kind and nervous, apologising quickly, words tumbling out, friendly, nervous, trailing off) says: "Hello, cat! I like your — your machine, it's very —"
Sound effects: fizzing wand, Sardine-Scanner beeps, ambience of echoing garage, the hum of machinery.
Audio: dialogue and sound effects only, no background music, no narrator other than the characters speaking. No subtitles, no captions, no readable on-screen text.
negative_prompt: live action, photorealistic humans, 2D flat animation, anime, sketch, subtitles, captions, on-screen text, watermark, logo, distorted faces, extra limbs, extra fingers, flicker, background music
